description.value: Big Way Hot Pot is a fast-growing self-serve hot pot chain founded in 2021, offering over 100 fresh ingredients and 18+ broths and dry mixes so diners build their own pot. The Gilmore branch in Burnaby is one of 18+ locations across BC, Ontario, and the US, and operates a join-the-waitlist system reflecting consistent demand. It's a substantial, full sit-down meal option for cyclists looking for a hot, customizable refuelling stop near the Gilmore area of Burnaby.
